answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the whisper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the reef until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quill of the next round. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing.
